reports.search_query: What version of YAML is in Kubernetes 1.31?
reports.direct_answer_summary: Kubernetes v1.31.0 utilizes sigs.k8s.io/yaml v1.4.0 as its primary JSON/YAML transcoder across the API server, kubectl, and kubelet. It enforces YAML 1.2 rules via JSON transcoding while pinning gopkg.in/yaml.v3 v3.0.1 for strict duplicate key rejection.

resolved_tree.role: Kubernetes JSON/YAML transcoder and admission boundary
Core YAML 1.2 parsing engine with strict duplicate key enforcement
Legacy YAML 1.1 parser retained for backwards compatibility across sub-packages

coexistence.divergence_analysis: Kubernetes 1.31 resolves YAML parsing through a dual-parser architecture. At the admission control and API boundary, sigs.k8s.io/yaml v1.4.0 acts as a strict bridge by transcoding YAML manifests into intermediate JSON representations before schema deserialization. This enforces YAML 1.2 plain-string semantics and neutralizes the Norway problem. Concurrently, gopkg.in/yaml.v3 v3.0.1 is integrated to provide strict duplicate key rejection, while legacy gopkg.in/yaml.v2 v2.4.0 remains pinned transitively across auxiliary CLI sub-packages, creating subtle parser divergence risks if external CRD operators bypass the standard sigs.k8s.io/yaml pipeline.

parser_hazards.title: The Norway Problem (Unquoted Country Code NO Coerced to Boolean False)
parser_hazards.code_bad:
allowed_countries:
  - SE
  - NO  # Evaluates to boolean false in YAML 1.1
parser_hazards.code_good:
allowed_countries:
  - "SE"
  - "NO"  # Preserved as string in sigs.k8s.io/yaml
parser_hazards.impact: Silent authorization bypass in geographic admission controllers when raw YAML 1.1 unmarshaling is invoked without JSON transcoding.

parser_hazards.title: Duplicate Map Keys Silent Overwrite vs Reject
parser_hazards.code_bad:
spec:
  securityContext:
    runAsNonRoot: true
  securityContext:
    runAsNonRoot: false  # Shadow key overrides in lax parsers
parser_hazards.code_good:
spec:
  securityContext:
    runAsNonRoot: true  # Rejected with parse error in sigs.k8s.io/yaml and yaml.v3
parser_hazards.impact: Admission control validation bypass where trailing duplicate keys overwrite earlier security parameters in permissive parsers.

parser_hazards.title: Octal Permission Radix Interpretation via Leading Zero
parser_hazards.code_bad:
volumes:
  - name: config
    configMap:
      defaultMode: 0755  # Decimal 493 in YAML 1.1 vs 755 in JSON mode
parser_hazards.code_good:
volumes:
  - name: config
    configMap:
      defaultMode: 0o755  # Explicit octal notation
parser_hazards.impact: Incorrect filesystem permissions applied to mounted volumes in Pod specs when different YAML specifications are cross-compiled.

cra_governance.reachability_classification: Production Reachable (API server admission & kubelet control loop)
cra_governance.reachability_rationale: Evaluated under EU CRA Article 10/11: sigs.k8s.io/yaml is directly reachable in core production binaries; hazardous unquoted type coercions are systematically eliminated through mandatory JSON transcoding.

advisories.reachability: Guarded: Crash vector in yaml.v3 alias resolution is neutralized by Kubernetes API server payload size limits and JSON transcoding.
Guarded: Uncontrolled memory consumption in yaml.v2 parsing is not reachable in default API server admission pipelines.

verified_facts.title: CWE-704: Incorrect Type Conversion or Cast
verified_facts.summary: Implicit coercion of unquoted country code tokens (e.g. NO) into boolean false in YAML 1.1 parsers.

verified_facts.title: CWE-471: Modification of Assumed-Immutable Data (Duplicate Map Keys)
verified_facts.summary: Shadow key injection where trailing duplicate dictionary keys overwrite earlier security parameters in lax parsers.

verified_facts.title: CWE-732: Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource
verified_facts.summary: Leading-zero octal permission radix interpretation differences in volume mount defaultMode (0755 vs 0o755).

verified_facts.title: CVE-2022-28948: gopkg.in/yaml.v3 Alias Resolution Crash
verified_facts.summary: Stack exhaustion / crash during untrusted YAML deserialization when resolving deeply nested anchor aliases.

verified_facts.title: CVE-2022-3064: gopkg.in/yaml.v2 Memory Consumption
verified_facts.summary: Excessive memory allocation in legacy yaml.v2 unmarshaler when processing maliciously crafted documents.
